notes: All six pages are Common Crawl (CC-MAIN-2013-20) captures of single-person 'Distinguished PhD Alum' profile pages from the Purdue Krannert alumni section; one snapshot per page, one record per page. Each page gives only the name, a current title and a current institution as of 2013: no graduation year, program/department, dissertation title or first placement, so listedYear is null and destination/position record the 2013 affiliation, which must not be treated as a first job. The sidebar 'Graduate profiles 2013 / 2012' name lists on every page are alumni-association profile navigation (not labelled doctoral; likely master's/MBA profiles) and were not recorded. The carolyn-woo, chris-muscarella and cynthia-montgomery captures were indexed under the www.krannert.purdue.edu host while the chunk URLs for muscarella/reibstein/hanssens use krannert.purdue.edu; sourceUrl copies the index lookup printed in each file. Discipline hints from titles (finance, marketing, business administration) suggest most of these alumni are outside operations; the integrator should check whether they belong in the population at all.
